reviews.owner_role: MAD4B repository CI source reviewer (not owner authorization)
reviews.review_rationale: Non-authorizing exact-source review of Feature 007 CI addition for SHA256-paginated dependency evidence verification. Historical delivery manifest hashes remain immutable. Release-critical root changes require separate governance-only PR and exact owner attestation. Exact later workflow successor adds one no-network negative Python test for the official GitHub/WordPress.org MCP Adapter installer origin, redirect and certificate authority policy; this does not alter deployment jobs, owner release approvals, role grants or source manifests. Retain preceding reviewed SHA explicitly; fail closed on any other workflow changes. Exact reviewed successor: execute tests/test_authorization_recovery_trait_nonregression.py and PHP lint for the first-party Authorization recovery trait before architecture audit; this source-only CI guard never authorizes a deployment or modifies WordPress grants. Reviewed exact successor adds a non-authorizing original content-readiness method-byte parity test and PHP lint for its two mechanically extracted first-party traits. Original source and permissions remain unchanged. Exact source-only successor adds first-party Core Web Vitals encryption/key/URL guard method-byte parity and PHP syntax, without changing workflow deployment or permissions. Exact successor adds a fail-closed WP-CLI bootstrapping fallback for the Adaptive Search PHP matrix after setup-php can report unsuccessful wp-cli tool setup without failing the action. It uses the official versioned WP-CLI 2.12.0 PHAR and validates its published SHA-256 before executing any downloaded PHP. A failed install, checksum or CLI preflight terminates CI. The existing source-only integration regression asserts this exact fallback and the immutable history is preserved; no Production source, grant, release or protected root workflow is changed.
